content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To buy some new hairspray, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Check current inventory of styling products (5 minutes)
Step 2. Compare prices between local pharmacies (30 minutes)
Step 3. Read ingredient labels for alcohol content (10 minutes)
Step 4. Decide on the specific brand to purchase (5 minutes)
Step 5. Look for manufacturer coupons online (15 minutes)
Step 6. Check store hours for the chosen retailer (2 minutes)
Step 7. Drive to the shopping center (20 minutes)
Step 8. Ask a stylist for a recommendation (10 minutes)
Step 9. Search for digital store rewards (5 minutes)
Step 10. Browse the hair care aisle (15 minutes)
Step 11. Select a travel-sized bottle for testing (2 minutes)
Step 12. Evaluate different hold strengths (10 minutes)
Step 13. Ask a friend which scent they prefer (5 minutes)
Step 14. Find a parking spot near the entrance (5 minutes)
Step 15. Identify hair type and needs (10 minutes)
Step 16. Read online customer reviews (45 minutes)
Step 17. Print out the discovered coupons (2 minutes)
Step 18. Check for "Buy One Get One" deals (5 minutes)
Step 19. Verify the car has enough gas for the trip (2 minutes)
Step 20. Make a list of other needed toiletries (10 minutes)
Step 21. Pick up the bottle from the shelf (1 minute)
Step 22. Watch a YouTube tutorial on hairspray finishes (12 minutes)
Step 23. Download the store's mobile app (3 minutes)
Step 24. Look for eco-friendly aerosol options (10 minutes)
Step 25. Compare nozzle spray patterns (5 minutes)
Step 26. Check the expiration dates on the bottles (2 minutes)
Step 27. Enter the store through the main doors (1 minute)
Step 28. Determine a budget for hair products (10 minutes)
Step 29. Search for a store associate for help (8 minutes)
Step 30. Filter search results by "Top Rated" (10 minutes)
Step 31. Check the store's "In-Stock" status online (5 minutes)
Step 32. Look up the address of the nearest mall (2 minutes)
Step 33. Put on shoes and grab a coat (3 minutes)
Step 34. Walk to the checkout counter (3 minutes)
Step 35. Double-check the price tag (1 minute)
Step 36. Consult a beauty blog for the best humidity resistance (20 minutes)
Step 37. Locate the hairspray section on the store map (2 minutes)
Step 38. Verify the bottle size meets TSA requirements (2 minutes)
Step 39. Ask a family member if they need anything (5 minutes)
Step 40. Read a magazine article about hair trends (15 minutes)
Step 41. Compare the cost per ounce (10 minutes)
Step 42. Check the store's return policy (5 minutes)
Step 43. Walk through the automatic doors (30 seconds)
Step 44. Wait for a staff member to unlock the security case (10 minutes)
Step 45. Research the difference between aerosol and non-aerosol (15 minutes)
Step 46. Set a reminder on the phone to go shopping (1 minute)
Step 47. Pick up a shopping basket (1 minute)
Step 48. Check the weather to see if high-hold is needed (2 minutes)
Step 49. Look for a "New Item" sticker (5 minutes)
Step 50. Scan the item at a price checker station (2 minutes)
Step 51. Locate the correct aisle number (2 minutes)
Step 52. Open the store app to find the loyalty barcode (2 minutes)
Step 53. Wait in the checkout line (12 minutes)
Step 54. Note the color of the packaging for easy spotting (1 minute)
Step 55. Inspect the bottle for any leaks or damage (2 minutes)
Step 56. Wake up and start the day (1 hour)
Step 57. Check if the store has a pharmacy section (5 minutes)
Step 58. Find the car keys (2 minutes)
Step 59. Look for a "Value Size" option (5 minutes)
Step 60. Check the UV protection rating (5 minutes)
Step 61. Read the store's weekly circular (10 minutes)
Step 62. Ask for a sample if available (5 minutes)
Step 63. Take a photo of the shelf for future reference (1 minute)
Step 64. Check for any "Clearance" stickers (5 minutes)
Step 65. Set a budget for the entire shopping trip (5 minutes)
Step 66. Write "Hairspray" on the physical shopping list (1 minute)
Step 67. Search for professional-grade brands (15 minutes)
Step 68. Check for a student or senior discount (5 minutes)
Step 69. Walk past the cosmetics section (3 minutes)
Step 70. Place the hairspray in the shopping cart (1 minute)
